messages:
ashok: Heads-up — nightly perf CI flagged a big p99 regression on small-batch for model-rl-7b on cuda-cluster-4. +22% p99 vs baseline. artifact: https://ci.redwood/bench/3421 :eyes:
maria: ack. can someone grab the raw trace and the env diff? I can start flamegraphs in parallel.
ashok: putting links — ci artifacts: https://ci.redwood/bench/3421/logs.tar.gz and docker diff in the run meta.
perf-bot: Auto-bench run 2145006790 completed. metrics: tokens/sec -3%, p50 -1%, p99 +22%. attached: /artifacts/2145006790/summary.json
devon: pinging kernel team — @liwei any recent scheduler patches rolled to cuda-cluster-4 last night?
liwei: short answer: yes, rolled a small dispatch reordering at 02:10 to reduce spin wait. rollout id: roll-2026-03-15-0210. will look at changes.
maria: starting a quick repro locally with the same batch size and sequence length distribution from the bench. command I run: ```runtimectl replay --run-id 3421 --seq-dist small --batch 8 --collect-traces```
ashok: if you see KV cache miss patterns, call out. this model is sensitive to prefix caching for small batches.
maria: quick note — initial flame shows a new hot path in kernel_scheduler::dispatch_loop, about ~18% of p99 delta. saving flame to GCS: gs://redwood-temp/flake/2145006789/flame.svg
devon: copying logs to /tmp/bench-3421 and will run the scheduler microbench. also re-running with the previous rollout (rollback) to confirm.
oncall-sre: FYI I've bumped capacity for the affected pool to avoid customer impact while we triage. not changing routing yet.
liwei: looking at the diff now — the reordering introduced an extra atomics path for some small tensors. adding a quick patch to skip that path for <128 tokens to test.
maria: repro with skip-patch applied locally drops p99 back ~20% vs baseline. looks promising.
ashok: great. can you open a PR with the revert/guard and link here? mark as hotfix.
maria: opening PR now: https://git.redwood/infra/runtime/pull/5792 — title: guard-atomic-path-small-tensors. CI running. :thumbsup:
devon: i'll queue a Canary deploy to the cluster after PR merges. timeline: ~30m.
perf-bot: Canary benchmark queued as run 2145006888. will post results.
maria: thanks everyone. follow-ups: 1) postmortem note w/ perf graphs, 2) verify rollback doesn't regress other workloads, 3) add unit test for dispatch path. I'll draft the note once Canary results land.
ashok: perfect. closing the loop after Canary. great async work. :rocket:
